name: Four bedroom tastefully decorated luxury İslamlar modern villa with seaviews
title: Four bedroom tastefully decorated luxury İslamlar modern villa with seaviews
description:
This luxury detached villa property is one of six " Kalkan Mountain Villas" located in Islamlar, an area of outstanding natural beauty in the foothills of the Taurus mountains near Kalkan. Only 20 min drive from Kalkan or Patara.

You'll find this small community of 6 mountain villas, each with 4 bedrooms. Prestigious gated community comprising 6 exquisite holiday villas with seaviews.

Each villa provides stunning views over glinting tomato fields to mountain peaks, Patara beach and the Turquoise coast of the Mediterranean, with even Rhodos visible on the clearest day. As the evening breeze cools and the sun gently sets, you can watch the stars above, and look down on the lights below.

Islamlar enjoys an ideal climate of warmth without the heat, and fresh mountain air without the cold. Life is easy with shared connections and facilities, lighted access road, mains services, telephone, broadband, maintenance.

Set among fields and lush forests of cedar and pine, olive groves, walnut trees and vine, the air is filled with the fragrances of jasmine, lemon and thyme. Small waterfalls, springs and mountain streams provide constant fresh water for Islamlar, giving natural irrigation, and feeding the trout pools that supply the friendly local restaurants.

Built on a bedrock of limestone and finished using local stonemasons and craftsmen, the villa is individually designed to fit naturally into the landscape. All stone carved from the bedrock is re-used in construction of the villas or boundary walls. Following the contours of the hillside, some villas are built on two levels, others on three.  The result is a unique contemporary design - spacious, full of natural light, and specified to the highest quality standards for the most discerning tastes.

Top architects incorporated the extraordinary views into each villa's design using large, picture-frame windows and sliding doors. You will look out over the Taurus mountains during breakfast, see Patara beach from your lounge - and swim toward the Mediterranean in your private swimming pool.

Open plan Living area has two sitting areas, fully fitted kitchen, dining area. Also on this floor is a utility room and cloakroom and access to first floor dining and seating area.

First floor There are two double en-suite bedrooms and entrance hall. . Sliding glass doors open to a large balcony that extends much of the width of the property and connects the 3 bedrooms. There are views across the Patara plains to the Mediterranean. Living area Stairs from the first floor lead down to the ground floor living area.  This is an open plan space that incorporates a sitting room area, fitted kitchen equipped to self-cater and a dining set up. Two large glass sliding doors to the front of this space connect the living area with some lovely views and provide for an extension of the living space to the swimming pool terrace beyond.  Marble flooring has been used in this space and throughout the villa. Ground floor has 2 further double en suite bedrooms and separate cloakroom, storage area. Outdoor area A private swimming pool at the front of the villa has terracing on two sides and is furnished with cushioned sun beds and parasols. Stone walls provide a degree of privacy at garden level and there is mature planting including palm and pine trees. At one side of the pool, a delightful dining area with shade is a wonderful place to dine and relax.

Each villa:

Spacious entrance hall Open-plan dining room Open-plan lounge with fireplace and library Fully-fitted open-plan kitchen Two master bedrooms, each with its own marble-finished en-suite bathroom, fully fitted with WC and bath Two guest bedrooms, each with its own marble-finished en-suite bathroom, fully fitted with WC and shower Marble floors throughout Marble-finished ground-floor terrace with generous infinity pool and outside shower West-facing balconies on all floors, accessible from living area and bedrooms Visitor WC Laundry room fitted with automatic washing machine. Landscaped garden

The three-level villas have a total floor area of 275 sq.m.The three-level villa also have an additional visitor WC. Plot size: 500m2

Structure

The villas are all built with a reinforced concrete frame. The floors are also of reinforced concrete. The walls, unusually, are of solid lightweight blocks. As well as stone and render facades. This improves sound and heat insulation.

Finishes

All floors throughout the development are finished in marble. The walls are smooth plastered in all rooms and painted white. Bathroom walls are of finest Turkish marble. The windows and sliding doors are all made of aluminium with double glazing throughout.

Fittings

All bathrooms are fully fitted with bath or shower, washbasins, mirrors and stainless steel taps and fittings. The kitchen is fully fitted with fridge, freezer, dishwasher, electric GAS hob and oven. The salon has a beautiful open log fire. Light fittings are included in all rooms with on/off or dimmer control as necessary. The laundry is fitted with washbasin and automatic washing machine. The entire villa is air-conditioned using Siemens or a similar world brand.

External

The outside pool area is finished with unpolished marble to give a non-slip finish. The pool itself has an infinity edge facing the Mediterranean and has blue tiles. There is an external shower and garden lighting for those warm summer evenings. Garden areas are planted with a variety of trees, shrubs and herbs, chosen by our landscape consultant. Where possible all existing pine trees have been protected.

The Site

Each villa is approached along a road which has been upgraded and widened. Street lighting and a natural stone wall have been installed to make arrival as pleasant and welcoming as the villas. Bougainvillea, jasmine and jacaranda trees fill the air with colour and aromas.

Please note: Foreigners not required to set up a company to purchase this property unlike other properties in rural areas. The price includes all fixtures, fittings and furniture- as seen.
